prompt: Create an original 90 second acoustic jazz instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: piano, upright bass, brushed drums. Style: relaxed swing, walking bass and conversational piano. Tempo approximately 100 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A smooth and relaxed jazz instrumental featuring a prominent piano melody, supported by a walking bass, light drums, and subtle electric guitar chords, creating a sophisticated and mellow atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首流畅轻松的爵士乐器乐曲，以突出的钢琴旋律为主，辅以行进的贝斯、轻柔的鼓和微妙的电吉他和弦，营造出精致而柔和的氛围。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
